description.value: Known locally as 'The Reading Room,' this volunteer-run community library is operated by the Roberts Creek Community Association and serves as a quiet neighbourhood institution on the Sunshine Coast. Membership is free and the collection spans fiction, non-fiction, and children's books with an emphasis on Canadian authors. A cycle tourist stopping in Roberts Creek will find a welcoming, low-key spot to browse books and connect with the community.

address.value: 1044 Roberts Creek Road, Roberts Creek, V0N 2W0
